title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Theater on 1969-04-26
lineage: cassette master > 1 cassette generation > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a legendary ’69 Electric Theater show with a mind‑bending Viola Lee Blues/Feedback/What’s Become of the Baby jam and standout Mountains of the Moon, recorded well enough to enjoy despite some muddiness.
ai_review.review: The performance is hailed as one of the most unique and adventurous shows from spring 1969 – highlighted by the extended feedback section after Viola Lee Blues that culminates in a rare PA loop of “What’s Become of the Baby,” plus stellar renditions of Mountains of the Moon and the Cryptical > Other One > Eleven suite. The soundboard source is generally clear, though a few copies exhibit hiss and occasional mud, and fans are frustrated by the missing encore on the official Dick’s Pick release.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for the musical performance (70% weight) and generally good soundboard quality with only minor hiss/mud issues (30% weight) lead to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most listeners find the board recording clear and balanced; a few report muddiness, hiss, and occasional inaudible moments on personal copies, but no major drop‑outs.

standout_songs: Viola Lee Blues > Feedback > What's Become of the Baby (PA loop)
Cryptical Envelopment > The Other One > Eleven > Other One > It's a Sin
poor_songs: Viola Lee Blues (noted as sloppy by one reviewer, though still intense)
show_quality.setlist_flow: A long, adventurous set with seamless transitions; the avant‑garde feedback jam serves as a centerpiece and the overall pacing is praised for its surprise elements and rare material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocals on “Mountains of the Moon” are described as passionate and lyrical.
